name: Route X3 (Public Bus)
address: Qawra Bus Station to Ta' Qali / Airport
price_range: €2.50 cash or contactless / Free with Tallinja card (for residents) or Explorer card
description: Public transport connecting Qawra to Ta' Qali (where BLAST Arena / MFCC is located) and Malta International Airport (MLA).
notes: X3 is a direct bus but can be slow due to many stops. From AX ODYCY, walk to Qawra bus terminal.

name: eCabs Malta
description: Local ride-hailing app, often considered very reliable in Malta.
notes: Highly recommended for event days due to direct point-to-point speed compared to buses. AX ODYCY to Attard (BLAST Arena) takes about 20-25 mins.

name: Bolt
description: International ride-hailing app widely used in Malta.

name: Uber
description: Global ride-sharing app, now operating in Malta.
notes: Sometimes slightly more expensive than Bolt or eCabs, but uses the same driver pool.
